cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Congratulate Through Your Teeth
cards.instruction: Perform warm praise while allowing competitive resentment to intensify beneath every compliment.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Congratulations on the prize. Such a lovely year for forgiving judges. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Are you saying I didn't deserve it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. I'm saying they saw past things I couldn't.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That isn't much of a compliment.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then admire how hard I'm working to make it one.

mechanism: A adjusts the wording of prize congratulations to retain B cooperation while each warmer replacement still exposes competitive resentment.
confusable: Unlike a plain insult, A continues trying to deliver socially acceptable praise while resentment intensifies.
comparison: Negotiated public congratulation differs from a promotion toast and vacancy grievance.
seedUse: D213-a forgiving judges and disputed compliment; S02-a lets B veto wording while preserving the praise performance.
